raw_segments.text: The devil fetched that harpoonier, thought I, but stop.
Couldn't I steal a march on him, bolt his door inside, and jump into his bed, not to
be wakened by the most violent knockings?
It seemed no bad idea, but upon second thoughts I dismissed it.
For who could tell but what the next morning, so soon as I popped out of the room, the harpoonier
might be standing in the entry, all ready to knock me down.
